name: When is the ideal time to start pre-listing home improvements before selling?

mainEntity.name: When is the ideal time to start pre-listing home improvements before selling?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ideal time to start pre-listing home improvements is typically 2-3 months before you plan to list your home. This allows ample time for planning, obtaining contractor quotes, and completing the work without rushing. For significant projects, like a full kitchen renovation, allow even more time. We recommend consulting with your agent early in the process to align improvement timelines with optimal market conditions in your specific area, ensuring everything is ready for a strong debut.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start pre-listing home improvements 2-3 months before listing, allowing time for planning and completion. Consult with your agent early to align with market conditions.
